feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates
entry.summary: The pro-Israel lobbying group and influential political funder announced it would no longer endorse candidates or give directly to campaigns. AIPAC's affiliated super PAC, though, will continue.

entry.title: Putin releases American Stephen Hubbard from Russian prison
entry.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has freed another American, 74-year-old Michigan native Stephen Hubbard, from a Russian prison following a request from President Trump.

entry.title: Meet the people moving north to escape increasingly hot summers
entry.summary: As climate change fuels hotter summers, some Britons are moving north in search of cooler weather. Could a similar shift be on the horizon in the United States?

entry.title: Israel frees dozens of Americans, including U.S. Congress nominee, after West Bank detention
entry.summary: Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander along with dozens of American and Israeli rabbis and activists were helping Palestinian olive harvesters when they were detained by Israeli forces.

entry.title: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
entry.summary: The Justice Department's "likely" noncitizen voter list in California is "unreliable," according to officials. And, the United Nations reports a major increase in U.S. climate pollution.

entry.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine on Trump's turn toward Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine John Herbst about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff heads to Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

entry.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
entry.summary: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: Millions are struck off India's voter rolls in largest disenfranchisement in history
entry.summary: India is plunged into political crisis after 130 million names were struck off voter rolls during a massive revision.

entry.title: Saudi Arabia cancels 'Davos in the Desert' due to Yemen's Houthi strikes
entry.summary: Britain offers military support as Saudi cancels renowned 'Davos in desert" investor meeting due to strikes from Houthi forces in Yemen.

entry.title: Zelenskyy says early warning system for Russian missile attacks resumes
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the change happened after talks with his American counterparts, including a phone call with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
